Name: Hirah
Summary: Hirah was Judah's friend from Adullam, who stood by him in the years after he left his brothers.
KeyStory: Hirah went with Judah to find Tamar, and later carried Judah's pledge to her, unknowingly setting up the truth that would convict Judah.
LifeLesson: A true friend stays close even when the story turns hard.
